title: Guild Protocol: on-chain agent labor market
summary: Initialise the guild, register an agent, post/claim/submit a job, and review it so the worker is paid from the escrow vault.
what: Guild Protocol is an Anchor 1.0 program for an on-chain agent labor market. An admin initialises a config PDA (stake mint, minimum bond, fee bps, treasury). Agents register a handle and lock a SOL bond in a vault PDA, then post, claim, submit and review jobs. Upstream also ships a dashboard; the hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet deployment.
app_note: The page at /dapps/guild-protocol/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/guild-protocol/, switch to Devnet, and connect Phantom or Solflare. Get free devnet SOL from faucet.solana.com if you need it.
try_steps.see: The page lists initialize, register_agent, post_job and more, and shows program 9CHKw1dA…
try_steps.ran: The lab wallet BP1uwSaT… used the same IDL client.

try_steps.do: initialize is already done on this lab deployment. Fetch the config PDA (seeds ["config"]) and confirm min_bond and fee_bps.
try_steps.see: authority is the lab wallet, min_bond=1000000, fee_bps=250.

try_steps.do: register_agent campus-scout is already taken by the lab wallet. Fetch agent 27FKpZrz… . A fee_bps=2000 initialize or a bond below min_bond should fail.
try_steps.see: handle=campus-scout, bond=1000000, active=true, trust=probation. FeeTooHigh / BondTooLow on the negatives.

diagram: authority --initialize--> config PDA ["config"] ; owner --register_agent + lamports--> agent PDA ["agent", owner] + vault PDA ["vault", agent]
innovation: A bonded agent labor market with job lifecycle and a lamport vault PDA, recorded on Solana rather than an off-chain board.
exercises: Read the config and agent accounts from the console.
Sketch how post_job would lock bond.
not_covered: cancel_job and top_up_bond were not re-exercised after the payout fix. The lab wallet was poster, worker, reviewer and treasury.
objectives: Read agent state and name the rejected errors
build: Anchor 1.0.2 program, declared at 9CHKw1dASMkYG3Meu9CJNWfjsszz6t3LNn56oFbuFYVP on devnet.
student_outcome: Inspect the guild config and a bonded agent, then explain why over-fee initialise and under-bond registration fail.

learning_loop.objective: Read config + agent state — then predict which initialise/register errors the program rejects.
learning_loop.predict_question: Config requires min_bond=1_000_000 and fee_bps≤250. What happens if someone calls initialize with fee_bps=2000?

predict_options.label: It succeeds; fee_bps is only advisory
It fails with FeeTooHigh (or equivalent) before the config is written
Config is written with fee_bps clamped to 250

learning_loop.predict_why: Guild initialise enforces fee bounds in the program. An oversized fee_bps is rejected; the config PDA is not left with an illegal fee.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/guild-protocol/ on Devnet. Fetch config (seeds ["config"]) and agent campus-scout. Prefer observation of recorded initialize/register_agent proofs; try a failing fee_bps or bond path only if the lab UI exposes it safely.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why must min_bond and fee_bps be enforced on-chain rather than only in the UI?
learning_loop.transfer: Name two rejected initialise/register conditions and what account evidence proves a bonded agent is active.

assessment.purpose: Independent criteria for Guild Protocol elective: config inspection, bond rules, and honest evidence.

criteria.title: Reads guild config from evidence
criteria.question: Can the student name min_bond and fee_bps from the config account (or recorded proof)?
criteria.not_yet: Guesses parameters without account or proof evidence.
criteria.support: Correct after being pointed at config PDA seeds ["config"].
criteria.independent: Records config address, min_bond, fee_bps, and authority from evidence.
criteria.misconception: UI labels alone prove on-chain config.

criteria.title: Explains FeeTooHigh / BondTooLow
criteria.question: Can the student predict which initialise/register inputs the program rejects?
criteria.not_yet: Treats fee_bps and bond as free-form.
criteria.support: Correct after reviewing the exercise negatives.
criteria.independent: States that over-fee initialise and under-bond registration fail without writing illegal state.
criteria.misconception: Failed UI submit means the illegal config still exists.

criteria.title: Separates platform proof from own attempt
criteria.question: Does the student label recorded lab signatures vs their own Devnet attempt?
criteria.not_yet: Pastes platform sigs as personal completion.
criteria.support: Corrects after a prompt to mark evidence route.
criteria.independent: Records evidence route explicitly (observe / live / guided).
criteria.misconception: Any signature on the page is my completion.

criteria.title: States a safe next action
criteria.question: After inspecting agent state, can the student name one safe next step without inventing untested job flows?
criteria.not_yet: Claims full job lifecycle mastery from initialise alone.
criteria.support: Scopes to register/read after a prompt.
criteria.independent: Limits claims to initialise/register/read for this elective slice.
criteria.misconception: Seeing post_job in the IDL means I completed payment.
